theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  rintro _ _ (h | h) μ
  all_goals constructor <;> intro s' ht
  case' choice.left => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case' choice.right => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  all_goals first
  | exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | refine Exists.imp (fun _ => And.imp (by first | exact Tr.choiceL | exact id)
      ChoiceBisim.bisim) ?_
    first | exact h.follow_fst ht | exact h.follow_snd ht
